projects.name: Geely UAE Launch
projects.desc:
Brand: Geely

Industry: Automotive

Market: UAE

Primary Role: Creative Director / AI Creative Specialist

The Brand:
Geely entered the UAE market in 2024, aiming to establish themselves as a new, technologically advanced automotive brand.

The Challenge:
The objective was to win the pitch and present a very clear direction for a TVC for their new electric cars, creating something culturally appealing that showcases how they are technologically superior in their price range.

The Work:
We developed concepts centered around friendships and staying up-to-date. The execution involved creating two fully ready animatics for two distinct electric car projects to secure the pitch and guide the launch campaign.

Deliverables & Technical Specs:

Media Types: TVCs, Animatics, Launch Campaign

Key Assets: Two fully ready animatics, Two TVCs produced for the launch.

Impact & Outcomes:
The brief was approved, leading to the successful creation of the launch campaign and the production of two TVCs that effectively introduced Geely's electric cars into the UAE market.

Two awards at Big 5 Egypt Impact Awards. MEP Project of the Year for the Central Cooling Plant. Digital Transformation of the Year. ACUD isn't just building a capital — it's setting the benchmark.

The presidents of DRC and Eritrea visited Egypt's New Administrative Capital. When foreign heads of state come to see what you've built — that's the kind of content that writes itself. Proud to work with @ACUD.
Smart recycling machines. The LA 2028 Olympics pipeline. A Green River running through a new capital city. ACUD is building Egypt's most ambitious urban project — and I'm helping tell that story.

projects.name: WallPost Software Platform
projects.desc: Full website copywriting for WallPost — a global business management software covering HR, CRM, Finance, Performance Management, and Advisory modules. Written to convert enterprise decision-makers.

articles.body: "From hire to retire." Three words to position an entire HR platform. Wrote the copy for WallPost's HR module — one central database for payroll, attendance, leave, and every employee request in between.

The best CRM copy doesn't describe features — it describes outcomes. "Enable your sales team to become more productive and efficient." Written for WallPost — a platform that tracks every lead from first contact to closed deal.
"Check your company's highs and lows without the hassle of creating graphs and charts manually." Finance copy that respects the reader's time. Written for WallPost's Finance module.

Performance management copy that actually performs. "Performance analytics, driven by individual KPIs, identify the department and employees that are negatively affecting the overall company statistics." — WallPost.

"Billable milestones are automatically linked to the accounts department so that revenue accrual and invoicing activities are captured in real-time." Advisory software copy that earns trust with precision. WallPost.
Five modules. One platform. HR, CRM, Finance, Performance, and Advisory — all written to convert enterprise decision-makers. Copywriting for WallPost Software.

"Not only can you see the actual company revenue, but you can also compare it with the planned revenue forecast and link it to sales and operations performance." That's the sentence that sells a Finance module.

projects.name: AI & Social Strategy
projects.desc: AI-powered content strategy and social media management for Mayo Clinic's GCC market. Developed influencer-led campaign frameworks, copywriting for X/Twitter, and patient communications automation.

articles.body: One doctor. One post. 26,800 engagements — at 4× less the cost of a two-month paid campaign. In the GCC, trust doesn't scale with budget. It scales with credibility.
Quality over Quantity. A single high-quality post from a trusted doctor nearly matched a full two-month paid campaign that cost 4× more. That's the power of authentic endorsement.
Paid ads can reach. Doctor-led campaigns convert. One influencer post: $2,875 → 26,800 engagements. Two months of paid ads: $11,763 → 20,495 engagements. The numbers don't lie.
In the Middle East, doctors aren't just healthcare professionals — they're the most trusted voices in the room. Their professional opinion is the single most powerful form of social proof.
These physicians don't just share a message — they advocate for it. Real cases, real outcomes, real trust. That's a narrative no ad budget can replicate.
The GCC high-net-worth audience doesn't respond to noise. They respond to credibility. Doctor-influencers are the direct channel to that community — and the data proves it.
7.27 engagements per dollar vs 1.74. The math is simple. Authentic advocacy will always outperform volume advertising.

brand.about: Mayo Clinic is an American nonprofit medical centre founded in Rochester, Minnesota, that treats patients, trains doctors and runs research.

projects.name: Eldib & Co Website
projects.desc: Full website design and copywriting for Eldib & Co — a global law firm with 150+ years of history and Egyptian roots, operating across North Africa, Turkey, and China. Built a digital presence that carries the weight of a century of legal expertise across six practice areas: Dispute Resolution, Labour & Employment, Transportation, Media & Entertainment, Corporate & Commercial, and Intellectual Property.

articles.body: "Century-old success combined with the agility of a start-up." That's the line I wrote to position Eldib & Co — a global law firm founded in 1875, operating from Cairo to Turkey to China.
150+ years of legal practice. Six practice areas. Offices across North Africa, Turkey, and China. One line to open the website: "A Global Law Firm With Egyptian Roots." Copywriting for @EldiboandCo.
"Eldib & Co caters to clients with global interests, ensuring their needs are met regardless of location." Writing for a firm that has operated longer than most countries have had constitutions.

"Whether working with established market players or supporting start-ups, Eldib & Co's skilled teams are adept at catering to businesses of varying sizes and types." The line that makes a 150-year-old firm feel accessible.

The oldest firm in Egypt providing intellectual property legal assistance. One of the largest compensatory awards in the Middle East region. The first firm to receive judgment via UAE regulation implementation in Egypt. I wrote the page that holds that legacy.
"From the stages of planning, we offer advice and document support to ensure all needed documentation is drafted clearly and correctly." Construction law copy — precision in every word, by design.
Representing Ivy League universities on IP rights in Egypt. Helping hotel chains navigate hospitality law across the region. Writing that carries the weight of the cases behind it — Eldib & Co.

"Committed to providing focused, timely, and personalized services, earning the firm a reputation for building lasting relationships with its clients." Copywriting for a firm whose reputation is older than most of its clients.

brand.about: Eldib & Co is a law firm with Egyptian roots and more than 150 years of practice. It works across North Africa and Turkey for clients with global interests.
